newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wanon Int'l in HK$55 mln property sale.
newsitem.headline: Wanon Int'l in HK$55 mln property sale.

text.p: Telephone manufacturer Wanon International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it has agreed to sell the whole of 18th floor in Metro Centre in Kowloon Bay to a third party for HK$55.04 million.
The company said a total HK$5.5 million deposit has been received and the balance of HK$49.54 million will be received on completion of the deal on January 28, 1997.
The property has a gross floor area of 23,225 square feet is currently 50 percent used by the company for office, research and development, warehousing and storage purposes, it said.
The company said relocation would not cause any undue disruption to its operation.
Proceed from the property sale will be used to expand the company's designing, manufacturing and selling of cordless and feature telephones, it added.
